Name: Better Hats API
Author: SummerFleur
Description:
[color=#d9d2e9][size=5][b]Better Hats API - A Content Pack Framework for Custom Hat Effects[/b][/size][/color]

Better Hats API is a comprehensive framework designed to extend hat functionality in Stardew Valley. It bridges the gap between JSON content packs and C# mods, allowing creators to implement complex hat effects through simple configurations while providing a robust API for advanced customization.

[size=4][b]🔵For Content Pack Authors[/b][/size]

Create hat effects using a declarative JSON system without writing a single line of C# code. Define buffs, conditions, and actions using intuitive configuration files with full IDE support via JSON Schema.

[b]What You Can Do[/b]

[list]
[*]Add every kinds of buff attributes to different hats
[*]Implement conditional effects using vanilla game state queries (time, location, weather, player stats, etc.)
[*]Execute trigger actions when conditions are met
[*]Set trigger types: equip once, check every second, on time change, on warp, or daily
[*]Support multiple content packs affecting the same hat with combined effects
[*]Full internationalization support for descriptions
[/list]
[size=4][b]🟣For C# Mod Developers[/b][/size]

Integrate your mod with hats through a well-designed public API. Listen to equipment events, inject custom logic, or modify buff properties at runtime.

[b]What You Can Do[/b]

[list]
[*]Event-driven architecture: [font=Courier New]OnHatEquipped[/font] and [font=Courier New]OnHatUnequipped[/font] events
[*]Inject custom condition checkers instead of JSON-based conditions
[*]Add custom action triggers for complex behaviors
[*]Apply custom buff modifiers to fine-tune effect properties
[*]Target specific content packs by ID for multi-pack compatibility
[/list]
[size=4][b]🟠Highlights[/b][/size]

The framework intelligently manages game events:

[list]
[*]Visualize all hat data, conditions, and combined effects in one click (by default is [font=Courier New]Ctrl + Alt + H[/font])
[*]Efficient caching and cleanup system
[*]Full validation and autocomplete support in IDEs via JSON schema
[*]Console command to reload content packs during development
[/list]
[size=4][b]🟢Getting Started[/b][/size]

[b]For players:[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Download Better Hats API
[*]Install some content packs
[*]Start Stardew Valley and enjoy it!
[/list]
[b]For developers:[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Download Better Hats API
[*]Create a content pack manifest referencing Better Hats API
[*]Add a [font=Courier New]content.json[/font] with hat configurations following the provided schema
[*]Check the [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/StardewMods/tree/master/BetterHatsAPI]GitHub Repository[/url] for documentation and examples
[*]Run the game and test your contents
[/list]
